caseStudies.title: Core strengths
caseStudies.subtitle: Where I add the most value as a senior full-stack engineer: technical leadership on product delivery, digital commerce architecture, and production-grade services.

platforms.imageAlt: Visual composition suggesting web platforms and product delivery.
platforms.title: Platforms & product delivery
platforms.description: I steer architectural choices and the evolution of complex web platforms with cross-functional teams—emphasizing quality, operational stability, and a sustainable delivery cadence.
platforms.detail: Turn business priorities into clear technical direction, raise the bar on code and process (reviews, testing, automation), and support team growth through hands-on mentoring.
platforms.stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js / NestJS, automated testing, AWS, CI/CD (GitHub Actions)

commerce.imageAlt: Visual composition suggesting headless commerce and integrations.
commerce.title: Headless commerce & integration ecosystems
commerce.description: Strong command of decoupled e-commerce architectures—catalog, checkout, and operations wired to payments, logistics, and partners—with a focus on performance and long-term maintainability.
commerce.detail: Consistent API contracts, less coupling across channels, and reusable integrations so new surfaces ship faster without trading off reliability.
commerce.stack: PHP / Laravel, REST APIs, MySQL / MariaDB, payment & logistics integrations

apis.imageAlt: Visual composition suggesting APIs, integrations, and reliability.
apis.title: APIs, integrations & reliability
apis.description: Deep skills in designing and operating REST and GraphQL APIs, backend services, and business-critical integration flows—with disciplined error handling and production visibility.
apis.detail: Pragmatic versioning, containerized environments, observability, and practices that reduce incidents and time-to-diagnose when things go wrong.
apis.stack: Node.js / Express, GraphQL / REST, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, APM & structured logging

stack.title: The Engine Room
stack.subtitle: My technical stack is curated for scalability, maintainability, and performance.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.context: Robust, performant, scalable interfaces for web products.

backend.title: Backend
backend.context: Services, integrations, and business rules with a reliability focus.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.context: Deploy, monitoring, and operations with a production mindset.

database.title: Databases
database.context: Modeling and dependable persistence as the foundation for apps and integrations.

design.title: Design & Tools
design.context: From concept to handoff—prototyping, visuals, and docs aligned with engineering.

legacy.title: Legacy modernization
legacy.body: I evolve legacy systems and APIs into safer, more sustainable solutions with continuous delivery and minimal operational disruption — hands-on in regulated, high-volume product contexts.

reliability.title: Production reliability
reliability.body: Maintenance, critical-scenario analysis, and root-cause-oriented fixes. I work with entrenched business rules and have shipped sensitive flows such as payment reconciliation with reporting and traceability.

observability.title: Cloud, deploy & observability
observability.body: I support releases with AWS, pipelines, and APM/monitoring tooling (e.g., Elastic APM, New Relic, Argo CD), shortening time to diagnose incidents and track system health.

fullstack.title: Full-stack & integrations
fullstack.body: APIs and apps with Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and React, Next.js, and Angular on the front, plus integrations and microfrontends when the context calls for it — from technical design to production features.

alignment.title: Business, quality & teamwork
alignment.body: Code review, stakeholder alignment, turning requests into fit-for-purpose delivery, and close collaboration with engineering and product — including regular interface with customer-success-style teams plus prioritization, acceptance criteria, and backlog ownership when the context calls for a hybrid technical-product role.

ux.title: UI/UX & usable product
ux.body: Background and practice in graphic design and UI/UX: consistent interfaces, operational efficiency, and strong user experience without sacrificing technical feasibility.

aiExploration.title: Applied AI for engineering, automation, and product
aiExploration.intro: I continuously study applied AI and already weave it into my engineering flow to think more clearly, prototype faster, and validate with sharper signal. My interest goes beyond casual AI use: I track agents, structured context, controllable workflows, and practical integration across product, engineering, and operations.
aiExploration.introBridge: In practice, it accelerates my loop from idea through validation, prototyping, and implementation, without giving up technical judgment.
aiExploration.dailyBody: The focus is clarity, iteration, review, and implementation: structured reasoning, shorter experiments, and code that lands with proper review. ChatGPT, Stitch, and Cursor go where they add speed; the final call stays with the engineer.
aiExploration.studyBody: Less technology laundry lists, more how the pieces connect: models, rules, tools, and context become repeatable, tunable flows. Exploration that returns to implementation, flow, and product, not just demos.
aiExploration.quote: I use AI to shorten the path from idea to validation to code, increase exploration speed, and expand how much I can execute, without outsourcing technical judgment.

llm.title: LLMs and agents
llm.body: I explore LLMs and multi-step agent flows with a focus on orchestration, assisted reasoning, and practical use in engineering work. I care about where those flows actually add value to engineering, not superficial experimentation.

assisted.title: AI-assisted development
assisted.body: Assisted implementation and refactoring, architecture exploration, and tighter cycles in the editor, with end-to-end technical responsibility.

mcpRules.title: MCP, rules, and context
mcpRules.body: How instructions, memory, tools, and execution connect: MCP and structured context for predictable flows; a useful system is more than a loose prompt.

agentEcosystems.title: Agent ecosystems and orchestration
agentEcosystems.body: Clawbot, Moldbot, and OpenClaw as reference points for roles, flows, and execution contexts. Hands-on experimentation focused on applied learning, including a personal workspace in that ecosystem.

image.title: Image generation and visual prototyping
image.body: Stable Diffusion, models, and LoRAs for fine control and fast visual prototyping. Midjourney, Stitch, and ChatGPT image generation when they help iterate concept, UI, and visual direction faster.

productDirection.title: Applied AI for product and real-world flows
productDirection.body: I think about where AI adds concrete value across backlog, delivery, automation, and everyday UX, not only as a roadmap concept. Execution that aligns with the team and the product in real use.

about.title: I'm Leandro Zanardo.
about.subtitle: Building the backbone of modern digital experiences.
about.p1: Full-stack software engineer with 10+ years of experience building web applications, APIs, enterprise systems, dashboards, and digital products.
about.formation: My background combines Systems Analysis and Development, Graphic Design, and a postgraduate degree in Software Engineering—a mix that strengthens how I work across architecture, product, and user experience.
about.p2: I work across architecture, legacy evolution, performance, observability, and UI/UX to deliver solutions that scale, stay reliable, and feel great to use.
